<documents>
<document id="security-scam-payment">
IfˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammerˆIfˆyouˆsentˆaˆBrookPayˆpayment,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆwireˆandˆthenˆrealizedˆitˆwasˆaˆscam,ˆtellˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆreportˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam.ˆThey'llˆcontactˆtheˆreceivingˆaccountˆorˆbankˆandˆtryˆtoˆrecoverˆtheˆmoney.ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed,ˆsoˆrecoveryˆdependsˆonˆtheˆmoneyˆstillˆbeingˆinˆtheˆotherˆaccount.ˆWeˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtoˆgetˆitˆback.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆincludeˆ-ˆTheˆpaymentˆandˆtheˆdateˆ-ˆHowˆyouˆwereˆcontactedˆandˆwhatˆyouˆwereˆtoldˆ-ˆScreenshotsˆofˆmessages,ˆandˆanyˆnames,ˆnumbersˆorˆwebsitesˆ##ˆProtectˆyourselfˆnowˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆsharedˆaˆpasswordˆorˆcode,ˆchangeˆyourˆpassword.ˆ-ˆDon'tˆsendˆmoreˆmoneyˆtoˆgetˆtheˆfirstˆpaymentˆback.ˆThat'sˆaˆcommonˆsecondˆscam.ˆ-ˆReportˆtheˆscamˆtoˆtheˆpolice.ˆ##ˆCardˆpaymentsˆareˆdifferentˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆaˆscammerˆbyˆcard,ˆyouˆmayˆbeˆableˆtoˆdisputeˆtheˆpurchaseˆwithˆtheˆmerchant.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchant".ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆusuallyˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-lost-stolen-v2">
LostˆorˆstolenˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆyouˆcanˆdealˆwithˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcallˆus.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆ**Freezeˆtheˆcard.**ˆTapˆCardsˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆThisˆstopsˆnewˆpurchasesˆrightˆaway.ˆ2.ˆ**Reportˆit.**ˆIfˆyouˆcan'tˆfindˆit,ˆtapˆReportˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThisˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanently.ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆundone.ˆ3.ˆ**Addˆaˆvirtualˆcard.**ˆYouˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆandˆinˆmobileˆwalletsˆrightˆawayˆwhileˆtheˆreplacementˆships.ˆ4.ˆ**Orderˆaˆreplacement.**ˆPickˆstandardˆorˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆReplacementˆandˆshippingˆfeesˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ5.ˆ**Checkˆyourˆtransactions.**ˆDisputeˆanythingˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize.ˆ##ˆDeliveryˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆYou'reˆnotˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆyouˆreportˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆIfˆyouˆfoundˆyourˆcardˆafterˆfreezingˆit,ˆjustˆunfreezeˆit.ˆNothingˆelseˆchanges.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
